constraints.rule: Preserve all live saved section areas, exact/flexible destinations, implemented placements and curator pins. Gaudiya17–19 is explicitly pinned. Newer live state always supersedes this snapshot.
Vitrine0 is temple context; never choose it automatically.
No identity links, names, section parents, canonical/public traditions or family memberships change. Keep repeated observations and shared objects distinguishable.

A current human-reviewed must-stay-together or separation decision overrides every suggested group and all spatial/tier preferences. No such reviewed family membership exists in this baseline; do not invent it.
Do not auto-place Needs Research, Needs section proposal, unlinked observations, or the explicit context holds. Do not create identities to fill sections.

Keep evidence-supported named relationships and provisional display cohorts together where practical; do not scatter a family merely to fill an upper-shelf primary area. Suggested family labels are not genealogical evidence.
Prefer Gaudiya19 facing Puri20 and southernDatta2/1 facing westernDatta11/12. These are schematic facing relationships, not measured distances or compulsory cabinet moves.
Use precise existing primary-tradition tags as within-section co-location hints. Do not form transitive union groups across display families, sections or broad Vaishnava/Advaita/Avadhuta names.

After keeping related units together, prefer physical upper display areas for current Featured/Primary and Secondary saints. This is a note, not a numbered shelf assignment; available upper space and tall/frame fit are unknown.

Balance observed frame/box/unknown packaging proxies across a section area after relationship preferences. Counts are demand proxies, never measured capacities. Do not equate photo availability with frames.
Suggestion is a reviewable draft; applying an area or destination must not assert physical movement or mark Implemented.
Clear/undo only the unchanged records created by that suggestion; protect pre-existing, subsequently edited and physically confirmed records. Use provenance plus revisions, not a broad reset.
